title: The release gate, and admitting a seventh family
design_ref: Evaluation: scorecards and no-regression gates; domains as plug-ins: admission test
purpose: Judge every model the earlier scenarios produced against the current release with the design's gate, and show that a higher average does not get a model through. Then admit a seventh family the way the contract says: a proxy run at a small weight, the transfer row and column, and the gate for the six families already there.

checks.description: the gate has a candidate to judge for every earlier result: at least seven models, each scored on all seven families
checks.because: Read from the bucket: S04's three mixtures and searched mixture, S05's three orders, S08's two merges.

checks.description: the gate passes the current release against itself and refuses a model that is better on five families and worse on safety by more than its tolerance
checks.because: The test is made of a model that raises five scores by 0.05 and drops one by more than its tolerance: the mean goes up, the gate says no. A gate that cannot say no is not a gate.

checks.description: a higher average does not get a model through: at least one candidate has a higher mean than the current release and is refused
checks.because: The design's scenario, on my own models: sequential raised the average and would have shipped under 'the average must go up'.

checks.description: the gate is not hair-trigger: at least one candidate passes
checks.because: The tolerance is the family's margin plus twice the noise measured over three training seeds; a model that is no worse than that on every family passes.

checks.description: admitting the seventh family: it learns (sorting rises by at least 0.10 over the current release), and the gate passes for the six existing families
checks.because: The contract's admission test is a proxy run with the new family at a small weight, the new family's row and column in the matrix, and the same gate for every family already in the mixture. Adding the seventh family needed one generator, one verifier, one registry entry and one run.

notes: Current release scores: math 0.438, code 0.741, instr 0.771, tools 0.892, multiling 0.699, safety 0.634, sorting 0.341.
